en: The image shows a historical black-and-white photograph featuring a building labeled 'STEINBA' flanked by trees. In front of the building there is a prominent war memorial (column with an eagle atop), and several people, some walking and some in a horse-drawn carriage, giving the scene a serene park-like atmosphere. The lower part of the card bears German text and publication details.
